terminal_name: Aphrodite / Cronos East-Med gas export (Block 12 / Block 6)
issue: OUT-OF-SCOPE for a Cyprus LNG terminal (documented so the gap is not re-chased): Cyprus's prominent East-Med gas export developments — Aphrodite (Chevron 35% / Shell 35% / NewMed 30%, Block 12; updated Development & Production Plan approved 2025-02-14) and Cronos (Eni/TotalEnergies, Block 6) — do NOT involve any LNG liquefaction terminal physically in Cyprus or Cypriot waters. Aphrodite uses a floating PRODUCTION unit (FPU, ~800 MMcf/d) above the reservoir feeding raw gas to Egypt via subsea pipeline; Cronos routes gas to the Zohr-area facilities and then to the DAMIETTA LNG plant in Egypt for liquefaction/export. The liquefaction terminal is in Egypt, not Cyprus. (A loose 'FLNG' phrasing appears in some secondary coverage, but the authoritative DPP describes an FPU + pipeline-to-Egypt, not in-Cyprus liquefaction.)
suggested_action: No Cyprus terminal to add. Any LNG-terminal capture of this gas belongs to EGYPT's records (Damietta), not Cyprus.
